description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Ulvenwald Mysteries' first ability triggers, creating a Clue, a Food, and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Cauldron Familiar's power.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food token, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
